021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.AbstractQSEvent;
022import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
023import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
024import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.tax.TaxRates;
025import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
026
027/**
028 * ShopEnhancedTaxEvent
029 *
030 * @author creatorfromhell
031 * @since 6.2.0.11
032 */
033public class ShopEnhancedTaxEvent extends AbstractQSEvent {
034
035  private final QUser user;
036  private final Shop shop;
037  private TaxRates tax;
038
039  /**
040   * Call when shop calc shop tax that will pay to system account and remove from shop owner/player
041   * received money
042   *
043   * @param shop The shop
044   * @param tax  The tax
045   * @param user The user (buyer/seller)
046   */
047  public ShopEnhancedTaxEvent(@NotNull final Shop shop, final TaxRates tax, @NotNull final QUser user) {
048
049    this.shop = shop;
050    this.tax = tax;
051    this.user = user;
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * Gets the shop
056   *
057   * @return the shop
058   */
059  public Shop getShop() {
060
061    return this.shop;
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Gets the tax in purchase
066   *
067   * @return tax
068   */
069  public TaxRates getTax() {
070
071    return this.tax;
072  }
073
074  /**
075   * Sets the new tax in purchase
076   *
077   * @param tax New tax
078   */
079  public void setTax(final TaxRates tax) {
080
081    this.tax = tax;
082  }
083
084  public void setInteractorTax(final double rate) {
085
086    this.tax.interactorRate(rate);
087  }
088
089  public void setShopTax(final double rate) {
090
091    this.tax.shopRate(rate);
092  }
093
094  /**
095   * Gets the user (buyer or seller)
096   *
097   * @return User
098   */
099  public QUser getUser() {
100
101    return this.user;
102  }
103}
